title: Figure Split Tiles
description: Add a general mechanism so a figure disposition can split into many crop-tiles with independent positions across arrangements (reveal.js auto-animate). Demonstrate in projektetage: catalogue figure splits into 3x5 grid, taken apart/scaled down, partial focus.
summary: Fixed regression: assigning columnMorphId to tiles broke catalogue→focus because tile data-ids no longer matched. Tiles always use tileMorphId again; split.columns adds invisible column morph layers (columnMorphId) for focus→labels. Catalogue split now includes CATALOGUE_ASSEMBLED_COLUMN_GROUPS so column layers morph across catalogue→focus→labels.
